name: @useyolo/subtitles-openai
description: Official Yolo AI subtitle plugin: speech to text and translation through any server that speaks OpenAI's audio transcription and chat completion interfaces, such as models the owner runs at home

summary.en: Subtitles made from a video's sound, through a server that speaks OpenAI's interfaces.
summary.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 接口的服务器，从视频的声音生成字幕。

privacy.en: Sends the sound of what plays to the server you set.
privacy.zh: 把正在播放的声音发给你设置的服务器。
